verdict.rationale: The only first-party off-ramp evidence is a one-line Bridge orchestration claim that it programmatically supports "off-ramps" (stripe-crypto-docs-40). Stripe's own stablecoin payouts run the other way: fiat is converted into USDC and sent to wallets (stripe-crypto-docs-23, stripe-crypto-docs-27). A community report says recipients must convert USDC back to fiat themselves, with restrictions, delays and fees (stripe-crypto-comm-11). Missing for 10: documented stablecoin-to-bank-transfer rails for recipients, a published list of supported fiat currencies and countries, details of off-ramp flows and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
